summary: scripts/security_gate.py gains an optional --summary-json PATH argument. When given, it writes a JSON file with the number of secret findings and the number of SAST findings per severity ({"secrets": N, "sast": {severity: N}}). The file is written before the decision, so it exists also when the gate blocks; the decision and the exit code do not change. If a report is unreadable the gate still exits 2 and writes no file. Six tests with small synthetic reports were added; red_check confirmed that five failed on the old code and the sixth is declared as a characterization test.
next: Consume the summary file in a CI job or in the dashboard if it turns out to be useful
